{{Quote|What say we find a bottle of something borderline toxic, go somewhere private, and then... Y'know... Share our woes.''"<br />"''You're drunk.|[[Deena Shan]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Rebellion 2">[[Rebellion 2|''Rebellion'' 2]]</ref>}}
'''Alcohol''', sometimes referred to as '''fire-water'''<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> or '''booze''',<ref name="E4N">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref><ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref><ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref><ref name="Honor Among Thieves">''[[Honor Among Thieves]]''</ref> referred to a number of beverages that contained [[ethanol]]<ref name="MedStarII">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref> and [[Octane/Legends|octane]],<ref name="SOS">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref> and had mind-altering effects on many organic [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="MedStarII" /> while in the [[Blood/Legends|bloodstream]].<ref name="DMSH">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref> It was viewed as a mild [[Poison/Legends|poison]].<ref name="RPG1">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>

Some types of alcohol would catch fire if ignited.<ref name="X-Wing: The Bacta War">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref><ref name="Interlude at Darkknell">{{StoryCite|story=Interlude at Darkknell|book=Tales from the New Republic}}</ref><ref name="Choices of One">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>

Operating a vehicle or vessel while under the influence of alcohol was considered very ill-advised.<ref name="Dooku Captured">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref><ref name="Legacy of the Force: Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref><ref name="RPG1" />

==Production==
The vast majority of alcoholic beverages came from [[Plant/Legends|plants]].<ref name="PG2">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Two]]''</ref> Most were created as a byproduct of natural chemical reactions involving plant matter, though synthetic variants did exist as well.<ref name="Beta">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beta|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Beta]]</ref>

Alcoholic beverages were made through processes of ''distillation''<ref name="GG9" /><ref name="AJ11">Roleplaying Game Statistics for [[Vici Ramunee]] in {{JournalCite|11|The Most Dangerous Foe}}</ref><ref name="Bar">{{StoryCite|story=Be Still My Heart: The Bartender's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref><ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref><ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref><ref>''[[Rebel Dream]]</ref><ref name="IC">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref> (like liquor<ref name="AJ11" /><ref name="IC" /> and whiskey,<ref name="Suns of Fortune 102">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref>) ''brewing''<ref name="GG9" /><ref name="Bar" /><ref name="Planets">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]''</ref><ref name="DS" /> (like beer) and/or ''fermentation''<ref name="SW24">[[Star Wars (1977) 24|''Star Wars'' (1977) 24]]</ref><ref name="Planets" /><ref name="Operation: Elrood (book)">[[Operation: Elrood (book)|''Operation: Elrood'']]</ref><ref name="DS" /><ref name="GG9" /><ref name="Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium]]''</ref> (like wine),<ref name="SW24" /> and were made from [[Grain/Legends|grain]],<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref> [[Corn/Legends|corn]], [[Wheat/Legends|wheat]],<ref name="GG9" /> [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]], berries,<ref name="GG9" /> plants and [[Tree/Legends|trees]]<ref name="GG9" />; there was even a drink brewed from solid [[rock]] (with the help of powerful bacteria and an unusual planetary [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]). [[Endrolian ground-apple juice]] wasn't supposed to be alcoholic, but would often ferment during storage.<ref name="GG9" /> Some types of alcohol were kept in special wooden aging casks over time, until the right quality was achieved;<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref> one example was [[Corellian whiskey/Legends|Corellian whiskey]]<ref name="Suns of Fortune 102" />

A ''distillery'' was a [[Factory/Legends|factory]] where strong alcoholic beverages, like liquor, were made through distillation.<ref name="AJ11" /> A ''brewery'' was a dedicated building for the making of ale.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> A ''winery'' was a building or property that produced wine.<ref name="End Game">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref>

==Types of alcohol==
{{Quote|Barkeep! Get me something tall, frothy and life-threatening!|[[Marn Hierogryph]], in a [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 12">[[Knights of the Old Republic 12|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 12]]</ref>}}
There were possibly more types of alcoholic beverages than any other type of food or drink in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Beta" /> Alcoholic beverages included:

*'''[[Ale/Legends|Ale]]''' - both generic and brand-named<ref name="DS" />

[[File:Drink_ingredients.png|thumb|right|190px|Ingredients for mixing drinks in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]].<ref name="Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> ]]
*'''[[Beer]]''' - both generic and brand-named<ref name="DS" />
*'''[[Brandy/Legends|Brandy]]''' - both generic and brand-named<ref name="DS" />
*'''[[Champagne]]'''<ref name="Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Shadows of the Empire'']]</ref>
*'''[[Cider/Legends|Cider]]'''<ref name="GG9" />
*'''[[Claret]]'''<ref name="The Mandalorian Armor">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>
*'''[[Cognac/Legends|Cognac]]'''<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>
*'''[[Grog/Legends|Grog]]'''<ref name="Rebel Force: Renegade">''[[Rebel Force: Renegade]]''</ref>
*'''[[Liqueur/Legends|Liqueur]]'''<ref name="Bar" />
*'''[[Liquor/Legends|Liquor]]''' - both generic and brand-named;<ref name="DS" /> rather expensive and classified as a luxury good<ref name="GG6" />
*'''[[Malt]]''' - both generic and brand-named<ref name="DS" />
*'''[[Mead/Legends|Mead]]'''<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>
*'''[[Rum/Legends|Rum]]''' - both generic and brand-named<ref name="DS" />
*'''[[Whiskey/Legends|Whiskey]]'''<ref name="MedStarII" />
*'''[[Wine/Legends|Wine]]''' - both generic and brand-named<ref name="DS" />

A distinction was made between '''beer''' (which included '''fortified beers''', '''[[Lager/Legends|lagers''']] and '''ciders''') and stronger alcoholic beverages (like wine and liquor), which were referred to as '''[[Spirit (alcohol)|spirits]]'''.<ref name="GG9" />

==Cultural significance==
{{Quote|Where are you going, Master?"<br />"For a drink.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]]|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
Virtually every inhabited [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] produced intoxicating drinks of some kind,<ref name="GG9" /> though on repressive or highly religious worlds, alcohol may be available only through the black market.<ref name="GG6" /> Depending on the world and culture, alcohol could be illegal, religiously taboo, commonplace or even an established part of everyday life.<ref name="Beta" /> Alcoholic drink could be made at home,<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref> or bought in special alcohol stores<ref name="IC" /> or intoxication retailers.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

[[File:Drunkspecops.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A group of intoxicated [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance operatives]]]]
[[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]], in particular, were hard drinkers, as evidenced by a plethora of types of alcohol and mixed drinks. However, the average Corellian didn't seem easily impaired by alcohol; some believed Corellians were extremely adept at holding their liquor, whereas others guessed that they only produced and sold the alcohol to other [[Planet/Legends|planets]], consuming only moderate amounts themselves. Some people even believed that [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] wanted to get the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] drunk and then rob it blind.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

[[Methyl alcohol]] was the drink of choice for [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fans]], just like water was to Humans.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>

''Mus'' was a name given to female [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabraks]], and meant "wine". The name originally referred to any strong alcohol that was used to cleanse wounds.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Economic significance==
[[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]],<ref name="Planets" />[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]],<ref name="CCW" /><ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] and [[Sacorria]]<ref name="CCW" /> were major exporters of alcohol, whereas wine was one of the major exports of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]<ref name="CCW" /><ref name="EA" /> and [[Glova]] . [[Seikosha/Legends|Seikosha]] was a major exporter of liquor.<ref name="PC">''[[The Politics of Contraband]]''</ref>

On many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], the tariffs on alcohol were high and alcohol smuggling was not uncommon.<ref name="The Last One Standing: The Tale of Boba Fett">{{StoryCite|story=The Last One Standing: The Tale of Boba Fett|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>

==Restrictions==
{{Quote|My brandy?''"<br />"''Mine, dear. You're too young.''"<br />"''Cut your ''tongue'' for a drink.''"<br />"''It's for your own good.|[[Ngani Zho]] and the young [[Teff'ith]]|<ref name="The Old Republic—The Lost Suns 3">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 3|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 3]]</ref>}}
Many [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] had prescribed a legal drinking age which prohibited the consumption of alcohol by minors or young people. For example, there were many planets where a [[Human/Legends|Human]] under 15 years old could not legally vote or drink.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'', Chapter Seven: [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] tells [[Ben Skywalker|his sixteen-year old son]], "there are plenty of places in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] where you can't legally vote or drink"</ref>

The [[Carosite]]s were not enamored with alcohol and the effects it had, both long- and short-term, on the physiologies on many beings. As a result, establishments that served [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]] were kept to a minimum and the liquor itself was taxed heavily.<ref name="Alien Encounters">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>

In the city [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Rise of the Empire era]], operating heavy equipment while under the influence of alcohol was a Class Three Infraction. The penalty for a Class Three Infraction was a fine of 10-1,000 [[Trugut/Legends|truguts]], depending on the severity of the crime.<ref name="Secrets of Tatooine">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref>

Although the [[Jedi Lord]] [[Valenthyne Farfalla]] was known to enjoy fine [[Wine/Legends|wine]] circa [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]],<ref name="JVS">''[[Star Wars: Jedi vs. Sith]]''</ref> alcohol was not recommended for Jedi both in that time and by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref> The [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] did frown upon [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] getting intoxicated, although this was a guideline rather than an actual interdiction.<ref name="MedStar: Intermezzo">{{InsiderCite|83|MedStar: Intermezzo}}</ref>

==Other uses==
Alcohol was a disinfectant.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Wild Space" /> Certain alcohols, such as [[ethyl alcohol]], could be used as a cleaning solution,<ref name="X-wing: Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref> and some types of strong alcohol were used to cleanse wounds.<ref name="GCG" /> There were even some types of alcohol, like [[Tihaar/Legends|tihaar]], that could be used to degrease engine parts.<ref name="O66" />

Alcohol was sometimes used as a food ingredient. It was also a good preservative. [[Ryshcate/Legends|Ryshcate]], for example, was a cake-like pastry that could be preserved and remain edible for [[Standard year/Legends|years]] and even decades, due to the alcohol used in baking it.<ref name="Suns of Fortune 102" />

==Side effects==
Alcohol had both long- and short-term effects on the physiologies on many beings.<ref name="Alien Encounters" />

===Short-term effects===
{{Quote|You're hanging out at Chal's drinking yourself under a table?''"<br />"''I'm relash- ''relaxing''.|[[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Shadow Games">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref>}}
The process of becoming intoxicated would depend on the alcohol content of the drink and the drinker's body mass.<ref name="courtship">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>

It was possible to overdose on alcohol;<ref name="courtship" /> a notable exception was a type of liquor called [[Lum/Legends|lum]], which, while alcoholic, was impossible to overdose on.<ref name="TM">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref>

<center><u>'''Common short-term effects of alcohol consumption'''</u></center>

'''Slower reaction time'''<ref name="Tof">[[Tof/Legends|Tofs]] in ''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref><br />

'''Lowered inhibitions; impaired judgment'''<br />
[[File:Share_our_woes.jpg|thumb|right|150px|A drunk Deena Shan comes on to Luke Skywalker.]]
[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] member [[Deena Shan]] admitted that she often made a pass on [[Gender/Legends|men]] when drunk.<ref name="Rebellion 11">[[Rebellion 11|''Rebellion'' 11]]</ref><br />
[[Architect/Legends|Architect]] [[Teela Kaarz]] became willing to go along with what anyone wanted just for the fun of it when drunk, which had gotten her into trouble more than once.<ref name="DS" /><br />
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Rebel Alliance member [[Jal Te Gniev]] was sought out by the young [[Dubravan]] [[Bobek]], who requested to join the Alliance. Gniev, drunk, blindfolded Bobek and had him walk into a trap door in the boardwalk, falling into the swampy [[Water/Legends|water]] below.<ref name="VQ">''[[Star Wars: Vader's Quest]]''</ref><br />

'''Impaired memory and comprehension'''<br />
Once, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was drunk and got lost.<ref name="Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref><br />
To get aboard a Hrakian [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] once pretended that the [[Hrakian]] [[Branox]] was their owner. Branox was so drunk he never really figured out what was going on.<ref name="Gambler's World">"[[Gambler's World]]"</ref><br />
In [[137 ABY]], when [[Pilot/Legends|Pilot]] [[Bushman Krentz]] was passing through [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] one night, he was so drunk that he couldn't remember where he parked his ship.<ref name="Legacy (2006) 38">[[Legacy (2006) 38|''Legacy'' (2006) 38]]</ref><br />

'''Increased self-confidence and courage'''<br />
[[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] pick-pocket [[Kabe/Legends|Kabe]] felt twice as quick and twice as clever with a little [[Juri juice/Legends|juri juice]] in her.<ref name="PIAFD">{{StoryCite|story=Play It Again, Figrin D'an: The Tale of Muftak and Kabe|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>

'''Violence and aggression'''<br />
The [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] [[Miner/Legends|miner]] [[Hurst]] often beat his son, [[Darth Bane/Legends|Dessel]], while intoxicated.<ref name="Darth Bane: Path of Destruction">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref><br />
During the period of time where [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Ros Lai]] was using a [[Mind trick/Legends|Force Illusion]] to disguise herself as a hideously deformed old hag, she was constantly ridiculed by her felllow tribe members, which turned to outright bullying when they were drunk.<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Infinity's End">''[[Star Wars: Infinity's End]]''</ref><br />
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], a drunken [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]] picked a fight with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Luckily for Skywalker, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] stepped in, resulting in Baba getting his arm cut off by by Kenobi's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="E4N" /><br />

'''Sexual violence'''<br />
Once, when [[Warlug]] and [[Tornik]], two of the guards in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], got drunk, they attempted to assault Jabba's dancer [[Yarna d'al' Gargan/Legends|Yarna d'al' Gargan]].<ref name="TfJP">''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]''</ref><br />
[[File:CorellianMerchantsGuild-GG9.jpg|thumb|left|255px|Wild partying among the [[Corellian Merchants' Guild/Legends|Corellian Merchants' Guild]].]]

'''Weakened motor skills'''<ref name="Cracken's">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref><br />
This could lead to unsteadiness and a staggering gait and movements.<ref name="TM" /><ref name="Shield of Lies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref><ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'', Chapter Fourteen</ref> Rebel Alliance member [[Fulkrehm Protial]] would use this to his advantage: His own motor skills were irreparably damaged and matched the intoxication-hampered movements of drunk people. He became an information collector for the alliance, by spending his evenings in seedy drinking establishments in the [[Kriz sector/Legends|Kriz sector]], listening to the conversations around him, while the patrons dismissed him as drunk.<ref name="Cracken's" /><br />

'''Becoming overly talkative'''<br />
According to Rebel Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]], drunks were extremely unreliable information sources; a being who is intoxicated is as likely to betray you as to provide useful information.<ref name="Cracken's" /><br />
[[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Theed Palace Guard]] [[Theomet Danlé/Legends|Theomet Danlé]] once turned to drink while feeling bitter, voicing his venomous alcohol-fueled complaints in a crowded bar.<ref name="DB-Danlé, Theomet">{{DB|character|theometdanle|Danlé, Theomet}}</ref>
After the Rebel Alliance's victory on [[Kalist VI/Legends|Kalist VI]], Deena Shan got drunk and babbled on about her sorrows; [[Deena Shan's father|her father's]] disappointment with her and being torn by her feelings for Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kale Roshuir]] and her loyalty to the Rebellion.<ref name="Star Wars: Rebellion: My Brother, My Enemy">''[[Star Wars: Rebellion: My Brother, My Enemy]]''</ref><br />
The combination of lowered inhibitions, impaired judgment and being more talkative than usual made it harder for a person to keep a secret. The Rebel Jal Te Gniev, having found his was to a [[Dubrava/Legends|Dubrava]] cantina and its intoxicating drinks, ended up revealing the name of the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who destroyed the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] (Luke Skywalker).<ref name="VQ" /><br />
The [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and [[Information broker/Legends|Information broker]] [[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Labria]] was often very drunk, but would sometimes fake drunkenesss to wheedle information others at the bar.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''</ref><ref name="EGC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref><br />

'''Fuzz-headedness'''<ref name="DS" />

'''A slurring voice'''<ref name="TM" /><ref name="Allies" />

'''Inertia'''<ref name="DS" />

'''Sleepiness'''<br />
This could result in a person oversleeping.<ref name="Bar" /> The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Kal Skirata]] had a glass of [[Tihaar/Legends|tihaar]] each night to help him fall asleep.<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>

'''Unconsciousness'''<br />
Large amounts of alcohol could make a person pass out.<ref name="TM" /><ref name="Allies" /> This happened often when [[Kabe/Legends|Kabe]] had too much [[Juri juice/Legends|juri juice]],<ref name="EGC" /> resulting in her adopted father, [[Muftak/Legends|Muftak]], having to carry her home.<ref name="PIAFD" /><br />
In some types of drinking competions, the last participant to remain conscious became the winner.<ref name="TM" /><ref name="Allies" /> One such drinking game was [[lumguzzling]].<ref name="TM" />

'''[[Hangover/Legends|Hangover]]'''<br />
Several hours after being drunk (usually the day after) the drinker could suffer a hangover,<ref name="SOTME">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref><ref name="Fair">{{InsiderCite|129|A Fair Trade}}</ref><ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> this would cause [[Headache/Legends|headaches]],<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref><ref name="Fair" /> sickness and other unpleasant symptoms.<ref name="RD" /> [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] suffered a hangover the morning after his [[Wedding of Revan and Bastila Shan|marriage]] to [[Bastila Shan]] because he got drunk after the wedding.<ref name="Revan" />

After [[Skirmish on Cloud City|escaping]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] Rahm Kota showed signs of suffering from a hangover, he stated to [[Galen Marek]] that he "started to wish that I had" after Marek remarked he was starting to worry that Kota had [[Death/Legends|died]] in his sleep.<ref name="fug">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

'''Dulling of the senses'''<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>

===Long-term effects===
{{Quote|Vease, sir, smav drink? Vickerman, vickerman?|A desperate Mimbanite alcoholic|<ref name="SOTME" />}}
The [[Liver/Legends|liver]] was one of the primary organs for processing alcohol,<ref name="Slave Ship">''[[Slave Ship]]''</ref> and heavy doses of alcoholic substances could damage it.<ref name="DMSH" />

[[File:Mimb.jpg|thumb|right|220px|A Mimbanite alcoholic licking alcohol off the floor.]]
Many beings, such as the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Ree-Yees/Legends|Ree-Yees]]<ref name="TfJP" /> and the [[Mimbanite]] of [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]],<ref name="SOTME" /> were addicted to alcoholic beverages. Others resorted to alcohol to drown their sorrows. Notable examples includes former lockbreaker [[Baco Par]],<ref name="Star Wars: Rebellion: The Ahakista Gambit">''[[Star Wars: Rebellion: The Ahakista Gambit]]''</ref> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] after the death of his friend and partner [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]],<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref><ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref> and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operative [[Margo Flarestream|Margo "Pepper" Flarestream]]. The latter was haunted by feelings of guilt and shame over the loss of many of her fellow Rebels and frequented the local [[Cantina/Legends|bars]] in an attempt to escape the ghosts of her past.<ref name="Cracken's" />

===Species significance===
{{Quote|Oh, I get it. So you can't get drunk.''"<br />''"Oh, we still can, and do. Just takes an awful lot.|An unnamed Human discusses Devaronian physiology with [[Madhi Vaandt]]|<ref name="Allies" />}}
Some species reacted differently to alcohol than others. Alcohol had an unusual effect on [[Tof/Legends|Tofs]]; it augmented their strength and stamina and sharpened their mental focus, at the cost of speed and reaction time. Most Tof warriors were drunk on the battlefield.<ref name="Tof" /> The [[Zelosian]]s couldn't get drunk on alcohol, but exhibited intoxication when they ingested [[Sugar/Legends|sugar]].<ref name="PG2" /> The [[Plant/Legends|plant]]-like [[Ergesh]] could not be intoxicated by most substances.<ref name="Alien Encounters" /> [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]] had a second liver, so therefore it took copious amounts of alcohol to get a Devaronian drunk.<ref name="Allies" /> The [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltrons]] also had two livers, which allowed them to enjoy a larger number of alcoholic beverages than other humanoids.<ref name="SOS" /> The [[Near-Human]] [[Ropagu]] did not consume intoxicants, as it interfered with their [[Brain/Legends|brain]] functions.<ref name="Alien Encounters" /> [[Yuzzem]] had extremely long hangovers,<ref name="SOTME" /> and alcohol would often provoke a depressed mood in [[Gand/Legends|Gands]].<ref name="HM">''[[Hard Merchandise]]''</ref>

===Force-sensitives===
Alcohol, like drugs, would blur a [[The Force/Legends|Force-sensitive's]] connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Wild Space" /> However, a Force-sensitive person was also able to use the Force to detoxify their body. This power made them able to remain sober while drinking large quantities of alcohol.<ref name="RPG1">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> A Force-user could also use a type of Force flow to make sure that the alcohol they consumed did not impede their senses.<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void" />

===Droids===
{{Quote|I-Five is ''drunk''?''"<br />"''I've been watching him for hours, and believe me, he's soused. If that's the proper term for a droid.''"<br />"''From a ''program''.''"<br />"''Yeah.''"<br />"''Which ''he'' wrote.''"<br />''"Right.|[[Jos Vondar]] and [[Den Dhur]], while watching I-Five|<ref name="MedStarII" />}}
[[Droid/Legends|Droids]] couldn't get drunk on alcohol, as they had no metabolism to process [[ethanol]]. However, some droids could be programmed to behave as if they were drunk. This was the case with the [[5YQ-series protocol droid]] [[I-5YQ|I-Five]], who was able to program himself that way&mdash;which resulted in him getting his arm ripped off after provoking a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who was a sore loser.<ref name="MedStarII" />

===Animals===
Animals were also able to experience intoxication. The [[ootak]] on [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]] was a primate known for searching out fermented fruit and proceeding to gorge until intoxicated.<ref name="Allies" />
